notes.raw:
\*Entropy at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 336.35 K, melting point of K; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.558$ kcal/mol. 
1043.7 K, calculated boiling point of K to ideal monatomic gas; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 19.038$ kcal/mol. 
1050 K, second order transition point of $K_{2}$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 
1221 K, melting point of $K_{2}$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 3.860$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-1050 K: $Cp^{\circ} = -3.365 + 33.940 \times 10^{-3} T + 9.863 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=-3.365\times10^{-3}T+16.970\times10^{-6}T^{2}-9.863\times10^{2}T^{-1}+2.803$ 
1050-1221 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 62.160 - 23.224 \times 10^{-3} T$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=62.160\times10^{-3}T-11.612\times10^{-6}T^{2}-35.426$ 
1221-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 24.130$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=24.130\times10^{-3}T-2.443$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-336.35 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -105.846 - 9.628 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 3.326 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 1020.450 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -105.846 + 9.628 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 3.326 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 510.225 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 41.544 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
336.35-1043.7 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -105.840 - 21.227 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 16.578 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 843.250 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -105.840 + 21.227 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 16.578 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 421.625 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 103.130 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1043.7-1050 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -149.045 - 16.551 \times 10^{-3} T + 16.566 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 569.250 T^{-}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -149.045 + 16.551 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 16.566 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 284.625 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 29.371 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1050-1221 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -187.274 + 48.974 \times 10^{-3} T - 12.016 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 417.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -187.274 - 48.974 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 12.016 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 208.525 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 432.407 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1221-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -154.291 + 10.944 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.404 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 417.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -154.291 - 10.944 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.404 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 208.525 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 149.276 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Johnson (57). Other data from Chase (17) who estimated entropy at 298 K.
